1
. This memo gives guidance on the Social Security (Income and Capital Disregards) (Amendment) 
Regulations 20251 [SS (I&C) (Amdt) Regs 2024], SI 2025/44. These changes take effect from 
28.02.2025.

2
. These regulations
1
 amend the existing regulations about which payments are to be disregarded as 
income and capital for the purposes of calculating entitlement to income-related benefits in order to 
exclude payments pursuant to the Ministry of Defence’s Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual and Transgender 
Financial Recognition Scheme

3
. These regulations
1
 insert new definitions for:

4
. "LGBT Financial Recognition Scheme payment” means a payment under the Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual 
and Transgender Financial Recognition Scheme administered under the authority of the Secretary of 
State for Defence
1

2(1)

(C)(Amdt) Regs 2025

5
. In the definition of qualifying person, an LGBT Financial Recognition Scheme payment is inserted into 
relevant legislation
1
. This means
 
 any person that receives a payment from these schemes is added to 
the definition of a qualifying person.

 Any capital which a person gets from the income or capital of the payment is disregarded

. LGBT Financial Recognition Scheme Payments are also disregarded for the following purposes:

1
. Payments to a Third Party in respect of a claimant or their partner
1

. Non-dependants’ gross weekly income for the purposes of calculating deductions for allowable
